calibration_note: Hand-drawn on the Ultralytics sample image (810x1080) BEFORE running detection, only to exercise each branch of the decision logic. These are NOT library seats; pixel coordinates are unrelated to the floor-map SVG.

seats.note: Deliberate limitation test: seat polygon covers the hip area of a STANDING person (beige coat). A box+ROI rule cannot tell standing from sitting if the ROI is not calibrated to a real seat.
Person (black coat) is next to the ROI; hip point outside the seat polygon -> expected ambiguous, not Occupied.
Empty pavement, nobody inside -> expected Available only after repeated clean frames.
Walking person on the right crosses the table polygon; hip point not in the seat polygon -> walk-through must not become Occupied.
